{{Top|leg}}
'''Toprawa City''' was the main [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]]. Amongst its locations were [[Al The Alchemist's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], and the [[Imperial Research Station/Legends|Imperial Research Station]] on its outskirts.

During the [[Battle of Toprawa]], destroyed ships falling from the sky dealt damage to the city.
